description: This Java source file defines the ContactsListFragment class, which displays and manages a list of contacts fetched from the Android Contacts Provider. It supports searching, contact selection, image loading, and list indexing. The class also includes inner classes and interfaces for adapter handling, querying, and event callbacks.

classes.name: ContactsAdapter
classes.description: Custom CursorAdapter for contacts, supporting section indexing and search highlighting, binding contact data including photo, name, and lookup URI to list item views.

methods.name: swapCursor
methods.description: Overrides swapCursor to update the alphabet indexer with the new cursor.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns number of items; handles null cursor gracefully.

methods.name: getPositionForSection
methods.description: Returns the list position corresponding to a section index.

methods.name: getSectionForPosition
methods.description: Returns the section index for a given list position.

methods.name: indexOfSearchQuery
methods.description: Finds the index of the search term within a display name for highlighting.
